title: MIGHTY Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
REPLACED BY MIGHTY+ USB-C

VENTY *NEW* BY STORZ & BICKEL NOW AVAILABLE

The MIGHTY portable battery powered dry herb vaporizer by Storz & Bickel, the makers of Volcano and Plenty.

A truly impressive portable vaporizer deserving of the name Mighty. The original king of top load portable vaporizers with digital display, full temperature control and a large easy to load bowl. The Mighty delivers great vapor and now features 20% more battery capacity vs the original Mighty.

Thanks to plus-/minus keys and the easily visible LED-display, the operation of the MIGHTY is simple: As soon as the actual temperature corresponds to the individually adjustable set temperature, the device is ready for use. This is additionally indicated by a short double-vibration. Through the setting options directly on the device, the personally preferred temperature can be adjusted gradually during vaporization.

Storz & Bickel is always working to improve their vaporizers. The MIGHTY has received upgrades like the boost feature and upgraded packaging.

Features:

- Battery powered

- Boost Mode

- Portable

- Vibration alarm

- Dimensions: 14 x 8 x 3 cm (5.5 x 3.2 x 1.2 inches)

- Weight: 235 g

- LED-Display

- 110 Volt

Delivery includes:

- 1 pc. MIGHTY Vaporizer

- 1 pc. Power Adapter

- 1 pc. Liquid Pad,

- 3 pc. Spare Screens,

- 1 pc. Cleaning Brush,

- 1 pc. Herb Mill,

- 1 pc. Filling Aid

- 1 Set of Spare Seal Rings

- 1 pc. Instructions for Use

GRINDER PACKAGE INCLUDES: 4 PIECE ALUMINUM PREMIUM GRINDER, 2 GRIME STICKS, 2 CLEANING STICKS, 1 CLEANING BRUSH

Warranty Information
